title: SSE and resilient HTTP streaming
subtitle: Deliver ordered server events with framing, reconnection, and honest completion.
goal: Understand one-way server events byte by byte
intro: SSE sends a stream of framed text events; network reads do not align with those event boundaries.
flow: Apply one typed event to UI state
case: A Unicode answer arrives across several network reads.
The browser reconstructs each complete event before parsing its JSON data.
Parsing each chunk independently creates intermittent failures.
